title: Add Graceful Shutdown and Signal Handling
description: Implements graceful shutdown on SIGINT/SIGTERM to stop accepting new connections, finish in‑flight requests, and cleanly close resources. Enhances production stability and supports zero‑downtime deployments.
testCases: Simulate SIGTERM while handling active requests and verify the server stops accepting new connections and exits with code 0 after completing in‑flight requests
Trigger SIGINT during idle state and ensure the server closes immediately and logs shutdown messages
acceptance: When the process receives SIGINT or SIGTERM, the server must stop accepting new connections, allow existing requests to complete within a configurable timeout (default 10s), close all listeners, release resources, log shutdown steps, and exit with status 0. If the timeout expires, the process should force exit with status 1.
reason: Production environments require reliable termination to prevent data loss and ensure clean restarts. Adding graceful shutdown removes a common source of instability during deployments and scaling events, aligning with the framework's stability focus.
